main_text.p: Animæ fidelium, si inquinatæ non fuerint, lætitia quadam spirituali exultant, ex perceptione precum pro se: si vero fuerint inquinatæ, perceptione precum pro se magis satagunt ad abstergendā sua Specula a maculis, quæ eis adhærent, ac tanquam submersi quidam a suis adiuti sociis sese mouent ad salutem. Ego vero maius agnosco emolumentum ex precibus, piorum porro hominum virtutibus præditorum, quia se conformando anima inquinata animabus eorum, diuinis informatis imaginibus, ipsa quoque deificatis illis sese infinuabit, & conformatione ad eas satis digna fiet. Infidelibus autem nulla prodest oratio, quia lumine carent, quemadmodum illa Samuelis minime Sauli profuit, & Hebrais illæ Prophetarum, qui pro eis grare satagebant. Hoc quippe redarguuntur: petitis, & non accipietis, eo quod male petatis.
Nestoriani in libro Constitutionum Ecclesiasticarum Collect. Hebediesu capite [illegible, ~25 letters]

page.notes: The Syriac heading at the top (four lines) and the Syriac line at the foot are not legible letter by letter at this scan resolution, so they are marked illegible. Possible printing error: "piorum" is followed by a dash mark at the line end; it is copied as "piorum" with the dash not reproduced. The catchword "De" is at the right below the last line. Long s is normalised to s and i/j to the Latin vowel/consonant form (e.g. "socijs" to "sociis" in the scan's spelling).
